import sys
import math

def power_mod(a, e, mod):
    if e <= 0:
        return 1
    x = power_mod(a, e // 2, mod)
    x = (x * x) % mod
    return (x * a) % mod if e & 1 else x

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    N, M, mod = map(int, input)
    factorials = [1] * (N + 1)
    inv_factorials = [1] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        factorials[i] = factorials[i - 1] * i % mod
        inv_factorials[i] = inv_factorials[i - 1] * power_mod(i, mod - 2, mod) % mod

    count_arr = [0] * (M + 1)
    sum_arr = [0] * (M + 1)
    count_arr[0] = 1

    for m in range(1, M + 1):
        for k in range(m):
            left_c = count_arr[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
            right_c = count_arr[m - 1 - k] * inv_factorials[m - 1 - k] % mod
            left_s = sum_arr[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
            right_s = sum_arr[m - 1 - k] * inv_factorials[m - 1 - k] % mod
            count_arr[m] = (count_arr[m] + left_c * right_c % mod * (m + 1)) % mod
            sum_arr[m] = (sum_arr[m] + (left_s * right_s + left_c * right_s + left_s * right_c) % mod * (m + 1)) % mod
            sum_arr[m] = (sum_arr[m] + left_c * right_c % mod * (k * (k + 1) + (m - k) * (m - k - 1)) // 2) % mod
        count_arr[m] = count_arr[m] * factorials[m - 1] % mod
        sum_arr[m] = sum_arr[m] * factorials[m - 1] % mod

    cnt_ans = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    sum_ans = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    cnt_ans[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(min(i, M) + 1):
            cnt_ans[i][j] = cnt_ans[i - 1][j]
            sum_ans[i][j] = sum_ans[i - 1][j]
            if j == i:
                cnt_ans[i][j] = (cnt_ans[i][j] + count_arr[i] * inv_factorials[i]) % mod
                sum_ans[i][j] = (sum_ans[i][j] + sum_arr[i] * inv_factorials[i]) % mod
            for k in range(1, min(j, i - 1) + 1):
                c = count_arr[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
                s = sum_arr[k] * inv_factorials[k] % mod
                cnt_ans[i][j] = (cnt_ans[i][j] + cnt_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c) % mod
                sum_ans[i][j] = (sum_ans[i][j] + (sum_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c + cnt_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * s)) % mod

    final_result = sum_ans[N][M] * factorials[M] % mod
    print(final_result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
